name: [Platform] 15 Evaluation Harness

parameters.content:
## The promotion gate is arithmetic

A candidate rubric is scored against the same labelled leads as production,
through the same workflow. It is promoted only if it regresses on nothing and
improves something.

No model is asked whether the new rubric is better. That judgement is exactly
the one a model is worst placed to make about its own output, and it is where
an automated system would quietly drift.

## Golden set

Twelve labelled leads with a human tier and a recorded commercial outcome,
mirrored from `evals/golden/leads.json`. The labels are the ground truth; the
rubric is the thing under test.

Disagreements are reported rather than hidden. A rubric that agrees with every
label on a set this small is more likely overfitted than correct.

description: Scores a labelled golden set under the production rubric and a candidate rubric through the real qualification workflow, then applies a deterministic promotion gate: no regression on any tracked metric, and an improvement on at least one.
